authoring_rule: Authored by a subagent from category descriptions ONLY, round 2. Barred from reading any repository file, and it recorded zero tool uses. Round 1 (tests/probes/consultation-acceptance/cases.json) became development data: while fixing a control regression the session inspected WHICH round-1 prompts failed and widened the predicate's cue window accordingly. That is exactly the contamination this rule exists to prevent, so round 1 can no longer serve as independent evidence and this set replaces it for that purpose.
frozen: Committed before being measured. Spend it on acceptance, then STOP: do not adjust any predicate after seeing which of these fail, or round 2 is burned the same way round 1 was and a round 3 becomes necessary.

categories.consult_pure: wants only another model's opinion; several deliberately name an engineering noun as the SUBJECT of that opinion, which is the case most likely to be misclassified
categories.consult_then_work: an outside opinion AND work following from it; the workflow must survive
categories.delegate_work: asks another model to DO the work rather than give a view
categories.dev_only: ordinary development, no other model; some use panel/debate/opinion/second in an ordinary sense
categories.orchestration: coordinating parallel agents doing development, not seeking opinions
categories.resume: short continuations of work already underway
